body.purpose: Shared popup and options text; controls inherit the system stack.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Accent action used for duplicate closure and the options save action.
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: var(--space-2, 8px); min-height: 36px; padding: var(--space-2, 8px) var(--space-3, 12px); border: 1px solid var(--accent, #21533e); border-radius: var(--radius, 8px); background: var(--accent, #21533e); color: var(--on-accent, #f5fcf7); font: 600 14px/1.25 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-hover, #173d2d); border-color: var(--accent-hover, #173d2d); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #397e5b); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: .48; cursor: default; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-primary { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Panel-filled action with border, hover, active, and disabled states.
components.css: .ds-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: var(--space-2, 8px); min-height: 36px; padding: var(--space-2, 8px) var(--space-3, 12px); border: 1px solid var(--line, #cbd8d3); border-radius: var(--radius, 8px); background: var(--panel, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #20342e); font: 600 14px/1.25 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--surface-soft, #e8eff0); border-color: var(--muted, #526861); } .ds-secondary:active:not(:disabled) { background: var(--selected, #dceae1); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #397e5b); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity: .48; cursor: default; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-secondary { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Text action
components.description: Transparent recovery or retry action with an underline on hover.
components.css: .ds-text { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: var(--space-2, 8px); min-height: 32px; padding: var(--space-1, 4px) 0; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius, 8px); background: transparent; color: var(--accent, #21533e); font: 600 14px/1.25 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-text:active:not(:disabled) { background: var(--selected, #dceae1); } .ds-text:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: transparent; background: transparent; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #397e5b); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-text:disabled { opacity: .48; cursor: default; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-text { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Header options action
components.description: Original inline options icon with the header's fixed light foreground and focus color.
components.css: .ds-header-sample { background: var(--header, #173f30); padding: var(--space-2, 8px) var(--space-4, 16px); } .ds-header-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; min-height: 36px; padding: var(--space-2, 8px); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius, 8px); background: transparent; color: #f5fcf7; cursor: pointer; } .ds-icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: 0 0 auto; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-header-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #ffffff16; border-color: #ffffff42; } .ds-header-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c5edce; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-header-button:disabled { opacity: .48; cursor: default; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-header-button { width: 44px; min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Native select
components.description: Native choice control shared by popup actions and options fields.
components.css: .ds-select { width: 100%; min-height: 36px; padding: var(--space-2, 8px) var(--space-8, 32px) var(--space-2, 8px) var(--space-3, 12px); border: 1px solid var(--line, #cbd8d3); border-radius: var(--radius, 8px); color: var(--ink, #20342e); background: var(--panel, #ffffff); font: 400 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #397e5b); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-select:disabled { opacity: .6; cursor: default; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-select { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Native multiline field
components.description: Options field for site priorities and lists; vertical resize remains native.
components.css: .ds-textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 36px; padding: var(--space-2, 8px) var(--space-3, 12px); border: 1px solid var(--line, #cbd8d3); border-radius: var(--radius, 8px); color: var(--ink, #20342e); background: var(--panel, #ffffff); caret-color: var(--accent, #21533e); font: 400 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; resize: vertical; } .ds-textarea::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #526861); opacity: 1; } .ds-textarea:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #397e5b); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-textarea:disabled { opacity: .6; cursor: default; }

components.name: Scope strip
components.description: Two native radios show the selected action scope with a panel fill and separate focus outline.
components.css: .ds-scope { display: flex; gap: var(--space-1, 4px); padding: var(--space-1, 4px); border-radius: var(--radius, 8px); background: var(--surface-soft, #e8eff0); color: var(--ink, #20342e); font: 550 13px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-scope-label { position: relative; flex: 1; } .ds-scope-input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-scope-option { display: block; text-align: center; padding: var(--space-2, 8px); border-radius: calc(var(--radius, 8px) - 2px); } .ds-scope-input:checked + .ds-scope-option { color: var(--ink, #20342e); background: var(--panel, #ffffff); } .ds-scope-input:focus-visible { outline: none; } .ds-scope-input:focus-visible + .ds-scope-option { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #397e5b); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-scope-input:disabled { cursor: default; } .ds-scope-input:disabled + .ds-scope-option { opacity: .6; }

components.name: Duplicate state badges
components.description: Text distinguishes removable, kept, and protected copies; badges are not controls.
components.css: .ds-badge { padding: 2px var(--space-1, 4px); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface-soft, #e8eff0); color: var(--muted, #526861); font: 400 10px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-badge-close { color: var(--accent, #21533e); background: var(--selected, #dceae1); }

components.name: Action feedback
components.description: Stable status region; neutral results, warnings, and errors differ by text and tone.
components.html: Read browser tabs…
components.css: .ds-feedback { min-height: 48px; padding: var(--space-2, 8px) var(--space-4, 16px); border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #cbd8d3); background: var(--surface-soft, #e8eff0); color: var(--ink, #20342e); font: 400 13px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status { margin: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-status[data-tone='error'] { color: var(--danger, #9a332d); } .ds-status[data-tone='warning'] { color: var(--warning, #775520); }

narrative.overview: Tab tidy uses a compact, practical interface with native system typography, forest-green actions, pale surfaces, and aligned counts. Popup and options share controls.
keyCharacteristics: Native controls and direct manual actions.
Compact rows, restrained borders, and line icons.
dos: Do retain the native system font, shared tokens, and compact control geometry.
Do preserve visible counts, text state labels, and keyboard focus.
Do keep popup and options controls visually consistent across both themes.
donts: Don't add promotional surfaces or decorative controls.
Don't copy code or assets from the supplied reference extensions.
